limitations: Cycles are strongly connected source-module components, not the number of individual circular paths.
Literal dynamic imports are potential edges; execution order, condition feasibility and laziness are not evaluated.

External packages, generated/ignored files, object reference cycles, memory leaks, asynchronous wait chains and database lock ordering are not assessed.
A zero module-cycle result does not establish absence of object cycles, leaks, deadlocks or all missing functionality.

tool.name: TypeScript AST and Tarjan strongly connected components

todo.scope: All tracked UTF-8-readable non-NUL files under code/.github/tests; exact uppercase TODO/FIXME word matches; no source lines or message text are stored.
todo.issue_rule: Issue references are GitHub #number, /issues/number or /pull/number links, and uppercase project-number IDs on the same line; remote existence is not verified.
limitations: Absence of TODO/FIXME is not evidence that all incomplete features are documented.
Issue references on adjacent lines or in linked documents are not associated automatically.
Only tracked files are included in this TODO/FIXME audit; new untracked source files are included only in the separate module graph.
TypeScript scanner comment classification is lexical; non-TypeScript/JavaScript occurrences are reported as text matches.
Issue existence, ownership, priority and completion status are not queried.

booleanConditions.scope: Current tracked and nonignored untracked code/**/*.ts and code/**/*.tsx source contents; generated/ignored files outside Git inventory excluded.

rule.ast: Visit IfStatement nodes only. Recursively unwrap ParenthesizedExpression; for BinaryExpression with && or || sum left/right leaves; every other expression is one leaf.
rule.nullish_coalescing: ?? is a nonlogical leaf; do not descend into it.
rule.other_nonlogical_expressions: Calls, comparisons, unary expressions and ternary expressions each count as one leaf; their contents are not flattened into the surrounding logical tree.
rule.conditional_expressions: Ternary conditions, loop conditions and JSX conditions are not independently scanned as if statements.

limitations: Candidate screening only; business semantics and necessity of each condition are not judged automatically.
No source text or sensitive condition values are stored.
This metric does not measure every logical operation nested inside nonlogical expression leaves.

secrets.afterScope: 469 tracked or nonignored new files; excludes ignored private files, dependencies, build outputs and Git history; default rules; fully redacted

strictDuplicationProbe.interpretation: 6 lines / 1 token produces overlapping low-token candidates; not semantically confirmed defects. Historical 6 lines / 50 tokens retained separately; zero-duplication not passed.
